name: Symmetric Inequalities via Undirected Sequencing
description: Replaces the "not equal" constraint (or set cardinality) with a requirement that "exactly one of the pair must have a strictly greater value than the other." A narrative about dynamically configurable data flow directions justifies why the constraint is symmetric (it doesn't matter which one is greater, as long as one is), disguising the graph coloring constraint as a local sequencing requirement.
